day_summary: BTC is trading at $63,711.26 at 11:01 UTC on Saturday June 20 — +$167 (+0.26%) from the June 19 UTC close of $63,544.43. The June 20 UTC session had a brief dip below $63,500 in the early hours (03:00 UTC low: $63,321) but recovered decisively — the early-session weakness was absorbed by Asian weekend buyers.
